$comment: Pipeline stages in order. gate.mjs reads this file. 'outputs' must exist ({competitor} expands to each competitor domain; a path ending in / needs at least one file). 'checks' are built-in checks in gate.mjs. 'npm' are npm scripts from docs/CONTRACT.md, run in order. 'manual' stages are recorded with the owner's confirmation; 'approves' names the file an approval stage pins by its content hash (the owner types APPROVE <hash>). 'when' skips a stage that doesn't apply. 'npmProduces' runs the npm scripts before checking outputs (they create them).

stages.summary: Domain, competitors and their DR (owner supplies DR), the technology, and the owner's idea in their own words; the lowest-DR competitor becomes the keyword seed
Structure, page types and UX gaps of each competitor, and how it serves the owner's idea, from public pages only; no copied text
The owner's idea matched against every recon file: visitors' jobs, coverage by competitor, gaps, ranked features, the wave-1 slice, positioning and open questions
The owner approves docs/IDEA.md as it is now by typing APPROVE <hash>
stages.manual: Owner typed 'APPROVE <hash>' in chat for docs/IDEA.md at its current content

stages.summary: Keyword Planner CSVs → keywords.json → selected.json → keyword-map.json
Content strategy, wave-1 briefs, JSON-LD plan per page type
90-day ADHD-friendly growth plan: one task a day, at most 45 minutes, a done check each
ARCHITECTURE.md and hosting target (Pages for a static export, Workers only for server code)
DESIGN.md in the google-labs-code/design.md format; AA contrast; self-hosted fonts
The owner approves docs/DESIGN.md as it is now by typing APPROVE <hash>
stages.manual: Owner typed 'APPROVE <hash>' in chat for docs/DESIGN.md at its current content

stages.summary: Pages, components and content from the keyword map, briefs and DESIGN.md; the owner's approvals still match IDEA.md and DESIGN.md
Unit and e2e tests for every new page type and module
The branch diff reviewed against CLAUDE.md, docs/CONTRACT.md, tests and security regressions; Verdict PASS with 0 blockers for the current HEAD
Keyword map ↔ pages ↔ design ↔ briefs agree; parity report against competitors
Titles, canonicals, sitemap, schema, internal links, depth ≤ 3; the 169-check on-page gate (stuffing, thin pages, titles, E-E-A-T, a11y)
AEO and GEO: AI crawlers per the bot policy, llms.txt, answer-first passages, entities, dates and sources
Required pages, consent, no ad code before approval, policy-risk scan
Secrets, CVEs, SAST, CSP, XSS, CSRF, path traversal, rate limiting, private-URL exposure, CDN-only, email spoofing
320–1280 px: no horizontal scroll, touch targets
Lighthouse budgets and Core Web Vitals limits from factory.config.json
PR to the production branch: preprod.yml (every gate) green in CI for the exact SHA
stages.manual: Owner or gh: preprod.yml is green on the PR to the production branch for this SHA

stages.summary: Free-plan Cloudflare checklist through MCP reads; writes only with the owner's yes
The owner types GO for the exact commit SHA
stages.manual: Owner typed 'GO <sha>' in chat for this exact SHA

stages.summary: Merge → deploy workflow → live check → rollback path recorded
PRD, DESIGN, ARCHITECTURE, SECURITY and the AGENTS.md project section regenerated from the agents' outputs
